_comment: Documented exceptions for tools/lint_team.py. move_gaps: moves confirmed legal in the mod but missing from data/mons/<stem>.json legalMoves[] (data gaps). ability_exceptions: abilities valid on a holder that are not present in the resolved species file (e.g. post-Mega abilities). Each entry needs a reason. Keep this small and sourced from notes/mod_days.md or confirmed memory.

move_gaps.reason: Standard meta move; JSON learnset gap, confirmed legal in mod_days.
Prankster Parting Shot is a real screens set; JSON learnset gap.
Corviknight's standard recovery; missing from JSON legalMoves (data gap).
Corviknight's standard hazard removal; missing from JSON legalMoves (data gap).

ability_exceptions.reason: Post-Mega ability (auto-crit on slicing moves); Pokepaste lists pre-Mega Vorpal.
